about: Cases of golden/cases.json the core cannot reproduce YET, and why.
The corpus is the contract of F11: every G# ticket closes when its cases
compare byte-identical against golden/metrics/. This file is what keeps CI
green in the meantime, and it is a checklist, not a carpet: a skipped case
is still RUN, and one that starts passing FAILS the suite asking to be
removed from here. Deleting your ticket's line is part of its exit criteria.
A reason names the capability that is missing and the ticket that lands it.
Where a case waits on several, the first named is the one whose exit

cases.states-tokens: Text metrics: the widths, line heights and baselines recorded here come from the rasterizer of G4 (ZAB-137). Everything else about this case — token resolution, the state merge, autofocus — already matches, so its diff is entirely Text nodes.
cases.text-wrap: The wrap pass: break points, hard breaks, maxLines, ellipsis and alignment — G4 (ZAB-137).
cases.unknown-type: Text metrics (G4, ZAB-137). The degradation rule this case records is already implemented: an unknown type lays out as a Container keeping its props and its children.
cases.bindings: Bound text, bound visibility and a bound Toggle — G7 (ZAB-140). Text metrics on top (G4, ZAB-137).
cases.collapse-tabs: display:none through a Collapse and an exclusive-select group — G7 (ZAB-140).
cases.disabled: The inherited disabled flag arrives with the data that declares it — G7 (ZAB-140) — over a Collapse, a ScrollView and three controls.
cases.assets-image: The asset manifest and an Image's intrinsic size — G5 (ZAB-138).
cases.scroll-clip: Scrollable extents and clipped subtrees — G6 (ZAB-139).
cases.transitions: Tweened values measured at rest, which needs both the clock and the transition engine — G8 (ZAB-141).
cases.overlays: The overlay layer in (z, document order), with a modal taking the focus with it — G9 (ZAB-142).
cases.anchors: Anchored placement with its flip and its slide — G9 (ZAB-142).
cases.controls: Toggle slots, both Slider axes, a bound ProgressBar and the Spinner wave — G10 (ZAB-143).
cases.textinput: Field geometry, the caret and the empty state — G11 (ZAB-144).
cases.settings: The whole F5 catalog composed as one screen, so it clears when its last piece does — the TextInput of G11 (ZAB-144).
cases.repeat: A bound array expanded into instances and virtualized — G12 (ZAB-145).
cases.gamepad-nav: The pad script: spatial navigation and stick scrolling replayed through the poll loop — G13 (ZAB-146).
